# of1p/backend/app/main.py

from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

import uuid

from fastapi import (
    FastAPI,
    Depends,
    HTTPException,
    Request,
    Response,
    Header,
)
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

from sqlalchemy import (
    create_engine,
    String,
    Integer,
    Boolean,
    DateTime,
    ForeignKey,
    Text,
    JSON,
    func,
    select,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import (
    DeclarativeBase,
    sessionmaker,
    Mapped,
    mapped_column,
    Session,
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuración
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=".env", extra="ignore")

    database_url: str = "sqlite:///./of1p.db"
    admin_token: str = "dev-admin-token"
    openai_api_key: str | None = None
    stripe_webhook_secret: str | None = None
    whatsapp_verify_token: str = "dev-whatsapp-token"
    public_base_url: str = "http://localhost:8000"


settings = Settings()

connect_args = {}
if settings.database_url.startswith("sqlite"):
    connect_args["check_same_thread"] = False

engine = create_engine(
    settings.database_url,
    connect_args=connect_args,
    future=True,
)

SessionLocal = sessionmaker(
    bind=engine,
    autoflush=False,
    autocommit=False,
    future=True,
)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def uid() -> str:
    return str(uuid.uuid4())


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Modelos
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=uid)
    role: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), default="customer")
    name: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=True)
    phone: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(
        String(30),
        unique=True,
        index=True,
        nullable=True,
    )
    email: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=True)
    language: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(8), default="es")
    consent_marketing: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False)
    consent_ai: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        server_default=func.now(),
    )


class Provider(Base):
    __tablename__ = "providers"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=uid)
    user_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("users.id"))
    legal_name: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(160), nullable=True)
    tax_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=True)

    # pending | active | suspended
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), default="pending")

    # pending | approved | rejected
    kyc_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), default="pending")

    # none | basic | full
    insurance_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(30), default="none")

    # Rating promedio * 100. Ejemplo: 480 = 4.80
    rating_x100: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0)

    completed_jobs: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0)
    payout_account_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=True)

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        server_default=func.now(),
    )


class Service(Base):
    __tablename__ = "services"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=uid)
    slug: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120), unique=True, index=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(160))
    category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(80))
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)

    price_cents: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer)
    currency: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(3), default="EUR")

    # Basis points. 2500 = 25%
    commission_bps: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=2500)

    # digital | onsite | hybrid
    delivery_mode: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), default="hybrid")

    # low | medium | high
    risk_level: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), default="low")

    active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=True)

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        server_default=func.now(),
    )


class Lead(Base):
    __tablename__ = "leads"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=uid)
    channel: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(30), default="web")
    user_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True)
    service_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("services.id"), nullable=True)

    raw_message: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text)
    intent: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=True)
    score: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0)

    # new | qualified | converted | discarded
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), default="new")

    # low | medium | high
    risk_level: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), default="low")

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        server_default=func.now(),
    )


class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orders"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=uid)
    user_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("users.id"))
    provider_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("providers.id"), nullable=True)
    service_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("services.id"))

    # created | paid | assigned | completed | disputed | cancelled | refunded
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), default="created")

    scheduled_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        nullable=True,
    )
    completed_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        nullable=True,
    )

    amount_cents: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer)
    commission_cents: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0)
    provider_payout_cents: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0)
    currency: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(3), default="EUR")

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        server_default=func.now(),
    )

    __tablename__ = "payments"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=uid)
    order_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("orders.id"))

    # En producción: Stripe PaymentIntent id.
    provider_payment_ref: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=True)

    # pending | succeeded | failed | refunded
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), default="pending")

    amount_cents: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer)
    currency: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(3), default="EUR")

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        server_default=func.now(),
    )


class Review(Base):
    __tablename__ = "reviews"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=uid)
    order_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("orders.id"), unique=True)
    rating: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer)
    comment: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        server_default=func.now(),
    )


class Dispute(Base):
    __tablename__ = "disputes"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=uid)

            "manitas",
            "persiana",
            "grifo",
            "electricidad",
            "fontanería",
            "fontaneria",

        ],
        "reparaciones-ligeras",
    ),
]


def assess_risk(message: str) -> str:
    text = (message or "").lower()
    if any(keyword in text for keyword in HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS):
        return "high"
    return "low"


def suggest_service_slug(
    message: str,
    services: list[Service],
    forced_slug: str | None = None,
) -> str | None:
    slugs = {service.slug for service in services}

    if forced_slug and forced_slug in slugs:
        return forced_slug

    text = (message or "").lower()

    for keywords, slug in SERVICE_RULES:
        if slug not in slugs:
            continue
        if any(keyword in text for keyword in keywords):
            return slug

    if services:
        return services[0].slug

    return None


def ai_intake_reply(
    message: str,
    services: list[Service],
    forced_slug: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    risk = assess_risk(message)
    slug = suggest_service_slug(message, services, forced_slug)
    service = next((s for s in services if s.slug == slug), None)

    intent = slug or "general"
    score = 70 if service else 20

    if risk == "high":
        score = 95
        reply = (
            "Esto requiere atención humana. "
            "Lo paso al responsable. "
            "Por favor, deja un resumen breve y un teléfono de contacto."
        )
    elif service:
        score = 85
        reply = (
            f"Podemos ayudarte con: {service.name}. "
            f"Precio aproximado: {format_eur(service.price_cents)}. "
            f"Modalidad: {service.delivery_mode}. "
            "Si quieres, te envío link de pago y agenda disponible."
        )
    else:
        reply = (
            "Cuéntame un poco más: ¿qué necesitas, "
            "en qué zona y con qué urgencia?"
        )

    return {
        "reply": reply,
        "intent": intent,
        "suggested_service_slug": slug,
        "risk_level": risk,
        "score": score,
    }

def get_or_create_user_by_phone(
    db: Session,
    phone: str,
    name: str | None = None,
    email: str | None = None,
) -> User:
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.phone == phone).first()

    if user:
        changed = False
        if name and not user.name:
            user.name = name
            changed = True
        if email and not user.email:
            user.email = email
            changed = True
        if changed:
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(user)
        return user

    user = User(
        role="customer",
        phone=phone,
        name=name,
        email=email,
    )
    db.add(user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)

    log_event(
        db=db,
        action="user.created",
        entity="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        metadata={"phone": phone},
    )

    return user


def active_services(db: Session) -> list[Service]:
    return db.query(Service).filter(Service.active.is_(True)).all()


def assign_provider(db: Session, service: Service) -> Provider | None:
    if service.delivery_mode == "digital":
        return None

    provider = (
        db.query(Provider)
        .filter(Provider.status == "active")
        .order_by(
            Provider.rating_x100.desc(),
            Provider.completed_jobs.desc(),
        )
        .first()
    )

    return provider


def create_order(
    db: Session,
    user: User,
    service: Service,
    provider: Provider | None = None,
    scheduled_at: datetime | None = None,
) -> Order:
    commission_cents = int(service.price_cents * service.commission_bps / 10000)
    provider_payout_cents = service.price_cents - commission_cents

    order = Order(
        user_id=user.id,
        provider_id=provider.id if provider else None,
        service_id=service.id,
        status="created",
        scheduled_at=scheduled_at,
        amount_cents=service.price_cents,
        commission_cents=commission_cents,
        provider_payout_cents=provider_payout_cents,
        currency=service.currency,
    )

    db.add(order)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(order)

    log_event(
        db=db,
        action="order.created",
        entity="order",
        entity_id=order.id,
        metadata={
            "service_slug": service.slug,
            "amount_cents": order.amount_cents,
            "commission_cents": order.commission_cents,
            "provider_id": order.provider_id,
        },
    )

    return order


def payment_succeeded(
    db: Session,
    order_id: str,
    payment_ref: str | None = None,
) -> Order:
    order = db.get(Order, order_id)
    if not order:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Order not found")

    if order.status in ["completed", "refunded", "cancelled"]:
        return order

    payment = (
        db.query(Payment)
        .filter(Payment.order_id == order_id)
        .order_by(Payment.created_at.desc())
        .first()
    )

    if payment:
        payment.status = "succeeded"
        payment.provider_payment_ref = payment_ref or payment.provider_payment_ref
    else:
        payment = Payment(
            order_id=order_id,
            provider_payment_ref=payment_ref,
            status="succeeded",
            amount_cents=order.amount_cents,
            currency=order.currency,
        )
        db.add(payment)

    if order.provider_id:
        order.status = "assigned"
    else:
        order.status = "paid"

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(order)

    log_event(
        db=db,
        action="payment.succeeded",
        entity="order",
        entity_id=order.id,
        metadata={
            "payment_ref": payment_ref,
            "amount_cents": order.amount_cents,
        },
    )

    return order

@app.post("/webhooks/stripe")
def stripe_webhook(event: StripeWebhookEvent, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """
    Webhook simplificado para demostración.

    En producción:
    - Verificar firma Stripe.
    - Usar STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
    - Idempotencia.
    - Reintentos.
    """
    if event.type != "payment_intent.succeeded":
        return {"received": True}

    obj = event.data.get("object", {})
    payment_ref = obj.get("id")
    metadata = obj.get("metadata", {})
    order_id = metadata.get("order_id")

    payment = None

    if payment_ref:
        payment = (
            db.query(Payment)
            .filter(Payment.provider_payment_ref == payment_ref)
            .first()
        )

    if not payment and order_id:
        payment = (
            db.query(Payment)
            .filter(Payment.order_id == order_id)
            .first()
        )

    if not payment:
        return {
            "received": True,
            "warning": "Payment not found",
        }

    order = payment_succeeded(
        db=db,
        order_id=payment.order_id,
        payment_ref=payment_ref or payment.provider_payment_ref,
    )

    return {
        "received": True,
        "order_id": order.id,
    }

@app.post("/api/reviews")
def create_review(payload: ReviewCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    order = db.get(Order, payload.order_id)
    if not order:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Order not found")

    if order.status != "completed":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Only completed orders can be reviewed",
        )

    existing = (
        db.query(Review)
        .filter(Review.order_id == order.id)
        .first()
    )

    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Review already exists")

    review = Review(
        order_id=order.id,
        rating=payload.rating,
        comment=payload.comment,
    )

    db.add(review)

    if order.provider_id:
        provider = db.get(Provider, order.provider_id)
        if provider:
            count = max(provider.completed_jobs or 1, 1)
            old_sum = (provider.rating_x100 or 0) * (count - 1)
            new_sum = old_sum + payload.rating * 100
            provider.rating_x100 = int(new_sum / count)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(review)

    log_event(
        db=db,
        action="review.created",
        entity="review",
        entity_id=review.id,
        metadata={
            "order_id": order.id,
            "rating": payload.rating,
        },

@app.post("/api/orders/{order_id}/dispute")
def create_dispute(order_id: str, payload: DisputeCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    order = db.get(Order, order_id)
    if not order:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Order not found")

    if order.status in ["cancelled", "refunded"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Order cannot be disputed")

    dispute = Dispute(
        order_id=order.id,
        reason=payload.reason,
        status="open",
    )

    order.status = "disputed"

    db.add(dispute)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(dispute)

    log_event(
        db=db,
        action="dispute.created",
        entity="dispute",
        entity_id=dispute.id,
        metadata={"order_id": order.id},
    )

    return jsonable_encoder(dispute)


@app.post("/api/disputes/{dispute_id}/resolve", dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)])
def resolve_dispute(dispute_id: str, payload: DisputeResolve, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    dispute = db.get(Dispute, dispute_id)
    if not dispute:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Dispute not found")

    if dispute.status != "open":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Dispute already resolved")

    order = db.get(Order, dispute.order_id)
    if not order:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Order not found")

    refund_cents = min(payload.refunded_cents, order.amount_cents)

    dispute.status = "resolved"
    dispute.resolution = payload.resolution
    dispute.refunded_cents = refund_cents

    if refund_cents >= order.amount_cents:
        order.status = "refunded"
    else:
        order.status = "completed"

    if refund_cents > 0:
        payment = (
            db.query(Payment)
            .filter(
                Payment.order_id == order.id,
                Payment.status == "succeeded",
            )
            .order_by(Payment.created_at.desc())
            .first()
        )
        if payment:
            payment.status = "refunded"

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(dispute)

    log_event(
        db=db,
        action="dispute.resolved",
        entity="dispute",
        entity_id=dispute.id,
        actor_type="admin",
        metadata={
            "order_id": order.id,
            "refunded_cents": refund_cents,
        },
    )

    return jsonable_encoder(dispute)

@app.get("/webhooks/whatsapp")
async def whatsapp_verify(request: Request):
    """
    Verificación estilo Meta WhatsApp Cloud API.
    """
    mode = request.query_params.get("hub.mode")
    token = request.query_params.get("hub.verify_token")
    challenge = request.query_params.get("hub.challenge")

    if mode == "subscribe" and token == settings.whatsapp_verify_token:
        return Response(content=challenge, media_type="text/plain")

    raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")


@app.post("/webhooks/whatsapp")
def whatsapp_webhook(payload: WhatsAppMessage, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """
    Webhook simplificado.

    En producción, adaptar al formato oficial de WhatsApp Cloud API:
    entry -> changes -> value -> messages.
    """
    user = get_or_create_user_by_phone(
        db=db,
        phone=payload.from_phone,
        name=payload.name,
    )

    services = active_services(db)

    ai_reply = ai_intake_reply(
        message=payload.text,
        services=services,
        forced_slug=payload.service_slug,
    )

    service = None
    if ai_reply["suggested_service_slug"]:
        service = (
            db.query(Service)
            .filter(
                Service.slug == ai_reply["suggested_service_slug"],
                Service.active.is_(True),
            )
            .first()
        )

    lead = Lead(
        channel="whatsapp",
        user_id=user.id,
        service_id=service.id if service else None,
        raw_message=payload.text,
        intent=ai_reply["intent"],
        score=ai_reply["score"],
        status="new",
        risk_level=ai_reply["risk_level"],
    )

    db.add(lead)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(lead)

    log_event(
        db=db,
        action="whatsapp.lead.created",
        entity="lead",
        entity_id=lead.id,
        metadata={
            "phone": payload.from_phone,
            "intent": lead.intent,
            "risk_level": lead.risk_level,
        },
    )

    return {
        "reply": ai_reply["reply"],
        "lead_id": lead.id,
        "intent": ai_reply["intent"],
        "suggested_service_slug": ai_reply["suggested_service_slug"],
        "risk_level": ai_reply["risk_level"],
        "score": ai_reply["score"],
    }

@app.get("/admin/metrics", dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)])
def admin_metrics(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    leads_count = db.scalar(select(func.count(Lead.id))) or 0
    orders_count = db.scalar(select(func.count(Order.id))) or 0
    users_count = db.scalar(select(func.count(User.id))) or 0
    providers_active = db.scalar(
        select(func.count(Provider.id)).where(Provider.status == "active")
    ) or 0
    services_active = db.scalar(
        select(func.count(Service.id)).where(Service.active.is_(True))
    ) or 0
    disputes_open = db.scalar(
        select(func.count(Dispute.id)).where(Dispute.status == "open")
    ) or 0

    paid_statuses = ["paid", "assigned", "completed"]

    gmv_cents = db.scalar(
        select(func.coalesce(func.sum(Order.amount_cents), 0)).where(
            Order.status.in_(paid_statuses)
        )
    ) or 0

    commission_cents = db.scalar(
        select(func.coalesce(func.sum(Order.commission_cents), 0)).where(
            Order.status.in_(paid_statuses)
        )
    ) or 0

    completed_orders = db.scalar(
        select(func.count(Order.id)).where(Order.status == "completed")
    ) or 0

    return {
        "users": users_count,
        "leads": leads_count,
        "orders": orders_count,
        "completed_orders": completed_orders,
        "providers_active": providers_active,
        "services_active": services_active,
        "disputes_open": disputes_open,
        "gmv_cents": gmv_cents,
        "commission_cents": commission_cents,
        "gmv_eur": round(gmv_cents / 100, 2),
        "commission_eur": round(commission_cents / 100, 2),
    }

Este código es una **máquina mínima de intermediación de servicios**. Convierte mensajes en leads, leads en pedidos, pedidos en pagos, pagos en servicio completado y servicio en reputación. Eso es el núcleo de una plataforma escalable.

Pero la escalabilidad real no vendrá de tener más código; vendrá de tres activos:

1. **Liquidez local**: proveedores fiables y clientes recurrentes.
2. **Datos propios**: qué servicios se piden, cuáles fallan, cuáles convierten.
3. **Confianza automatizada**: pagos seguros, reseñas verificadas, disputas rápidas y auditoría.

He leído el archivo completo. La idea es potente, pero el chat anterior tiene tres defectos estructurales: **exceso de scope**, **promesas de “blindaje total” poco realistas** y **falta de un núcleo económico/legal/operativo verificable**. La mejora correcta no es añadir más agentes, sino convertirlo en un sistema ejecutable, auditable y escalable con supervisión humana.

A continuación te dejo la **versión mejorada y definitiva**: **SAIPS-AMOS Lite v3**.

---

# 1. Nota de contexto y privacidad

Si “Renclusa 9, Pubilla Cases” es tu ubicación real, trátala como dato privado operativo. No la publiques en landings, prompts, logs, repositorios ni bases de datos. Úsala solo como nodo inicial de validación en L’Hospitalet de Llobregat / Barcelona metropolitana.

Esto no es asesoramiento legal, fiscal ni financiero. Para producción real, valida con abogado, gestor fiscal y laboralista en España/UE.

---

# 2. Diagnóstico del chat anterior

| Aspecto | Lo que había | Problema | Mejora v3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Visión | Marketplace + IA + arbitraje de servicios | Correcta | Se mantiene |
| Ambición | “Sistema autónomo mundial” | Scope excesivo | AMOS-Lite por capacidades y fases |
| Automatización | Muchos agentes | Complejidad y riesgo | 8 agentes iniciales con límites |
| Pagos | Stripe Connect mencionado | Faltaba ledger, idempotencia, disputas | Ledger doble, webhook verificado, escrow |
| Legal | RGPD, AI Act mencionados | Faltaba P2B, DSA, PSD2, DAC7, laboral | Paquete legal completo |
| IA | GPT/Claude | Faltaba eval, prompt injection, trazabilidad | Evals, logs, sandbox, aprobación humana |
| Negocio | 20 servicios | Dispersión | 3 servicios iniciales |
| Mantenimiento | “Coste cero” | No realista | Coste bajo y medido |
| Expansión | Copiar ciudad | Sin criterios | Stage-gate con kill criteria |
| Seguridad | “Blindado” | Término absoluto | Zero Trust + auditoría + seguros |
| Datos | Scraping/tendencias | Riesgo legal | APIs lícitas, consentimiento, datos abiertos |
| Finanzas | GMV/comisión | Faltaba contribución neta | Unit economics + ledger + presupuesto |
| Operación | 1 persona + IA | Faltaba rutina y SOPs | Dashboard diario + aprobaciones + SOPs |

---

# 3. Resumen ejecutivo de SAIPS-AMOS Lite v3

## Definición

**SAIPS-AMOS Lite v3** es un sistema operativo empresarial para una persona + IA que:

1. Detecta necesidades locales y digitales.
2. Valida demanda con experimentos baratos.
3. Crea o activa servicios paquetizados.
4. Conecta clientes con proveedores o produce digitalmente.
5. Cobra mediante rails regulados.
6. Liquida comisiones con trazabilidad.
7. Aprende con experimentación controlada.
8. Escala solo cuando hay contribución positiva.

## Tesis central

No construyas una “empresa autónoma mundial”. Construye una **máquina de liquidez local** con tres motores:

```text
Motor 1: Validación barata
Motor 2: Producción/intermediación rentable
Motor 3: Gobierno, seguridad y auto-mejora limitada
```

## North Star Metric

```text
Pedidos completados con contribución positiva por barrio y semana
```

No GMV. No leads. No tráfico.

**Métrica correcta:**

```text
Contribución neta semanal por barrio =
  ingresos por comisión/suscripción
− coste variable de servicio
− fees de pago
− disputas/reembolsos
− CAC variable
− coste IA/mensajería
```

## Principios v3

1. **Validar antes de automatizar.**
2. **Ingresos antes que agentes.**
3. **Menos piezas, más liquidez.**
4. **Dinero con ledger y entidad regulada.**
5. **IA con límites, logs y aprobación humana.**
6. **Expansión por cohortes, no por fantasía.**
7. **Matar rápido lo que no contribuye.**
8. **Blindaje = cumplimiento + seguridad + seguros + auditoría, no opacidad.**

---

# 4. Arquitectura mejorada por capacidades

En lugar de organizar el sistema por páginas o agentes sueltos, organízalo por **capacidades empresariales**.

| Capacidad | Función | Entrada | Salida | Control | KPI |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Discovery Engine | Detectar necesidades | Trends, CRM, reseñas, datos abiertos | Oportunidades | Fuentes lícitas | Oportunidades válidas/semana |
| Validation Engine | Experimentar | Oportunidad | Landing, oferta, preorder | Presupuesto límite | Tasa de validación |
| Catalog Engine | Paquetizar | Servicio validado | SKU con precio/SLA | Aprobación legal | SKUs activos rentables |
| Intake Engine | Atender leads | WhatsApp/web | Lead clasificado | Filtros de riesgo | Primera respuesta <2 min |
| Matching Engine | Asignar proveedor | Pedido | Proveedor o fábrica digital | Fairness, disponibilidad | Match rate |
| Fulfillment Engine | Ejecutar servicio | Pedido pagado | Servicio entregado | QA, evidencias | % entrega a tiempo |
| Payments/Ledger Engine | Cobrar/liquidar | Pedido | Pago, comisión, payout | Stripe + ledger doble | Fraude, chargebacks |
| Trust/Safety Engine | Reputación/disputas | Reseñas, incidencias | Confianza | Mediación humana | Disputas <3% |
| Growth Engine | Captación | Canales | Leads | CAC/LTV | CAC payback |
| Finance Engine | Control económico | Ledger | Margen, cash flow | Conciliación | Contribución neta |
| Compliance Engine | Legal/IA/datos | Eventos | Cumplimiento | AI Act, RGPD, P2B | Incidentes regulatorios |
| Learning Engine | Optimizar | KPIs, experimentos | Cambios probados | Evals, canary | Lift de conversión |
| Governance Engine | Aprobar cambios | Riesgo/coste | Go/no-go | Humano | Decisiones auditadas |

---

# 5. Diferencia entre v1, v2 y v3

| Dimensión | v1 | v2 | v3 mejorada |
|---|---|---|---|
| Modelo | Marketplace local | SAIPS con agentes | Sistema operativo por capacidades |
| Agentes | Pocos | Enjambre | Agentes acotados |
| Dinero | Stripe simulado | Stripe Connect | Stripe + ledger + idempotencia |
| IA | Reglas | GPT/Claude | Structured output + evals + logs |
| Legal | Documentos básicos | RGPD/AI Act | RGPD + AI Act + P2B + DSA + PSD2 + DAC7 |
| Expansión | Copiar ciudad | Playbook | Stage-gate con kill criteria |
| Auto-mejora | A/B simple | Autoactualización | Sandbox + shadow + canary + aprobación |
| Operación | Founder hace todo | Founder supervisa | Rutina diaria + SOPs + alertas |
| Riesgo | Optimista | “Blindado” | Gestionado, asegurado y auditado |

---

# 6. Modelo de negocio mejorado

## Regla estratégica

Para máximo rendimiento económico con bajo mantenimiento, prioriza en este orden:

1. **Servicios digitales recurrentes B2B**: margen alto, ejecución remota, menos disputas.
2. **Servicios presenciales de confianza**: alta demanda local, boca-oreja, pero más operación.
3. **Marketplace físico puro**: escalable, pero más riesgo laboral, calidad y disputas.

## Catálogo inicial recomendado: solo 3 servicios

No lances 20 servicios. Lanza 3 con SLA claro.

| Servicio | Precio | Modalidad | Margen estimado | Riesgo | Automatización |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|---:|
| Soporte digital antiestafas para mayores | 39 € | Presencial/híbrido | Medio-alto | Bajo | Media |
| Google Business + reseñas para comercios | 99 € setup + 49 €/mes | Digital | Alto | Bajo | Alta |
| Acompañamiento digital mensual | 19 €/mes | Recurrente | Alto | Bajo | Alta |

## Por qué estos tres

- Dolor claro.
- Pago inmediato.
- Bajo riesgo regulatorio si no haces asesoría legal/fiscal/sanitaria.
- Recurrencia posible.
- Fácil automatización de marketing, informes y soporte.
- Compatible con validación en Pubilla Cases.

---

# 7. Unit economics mejorados

## Ejemplo 1: Servicio presencial 39 €

| Concepto | Importe |
|---|---:|
| Precio cliente | 39 € |
| Comisión plataforma 25% | 9,75 € |
| Fee pago aproximado | 1,20 € |
| Coste IA/mensajería | 0,30 € |
| Coste soporte/disputa estimado | 1,00 € |
| Contribución bruta | 7,25 € |

Si el proveedor hace el servicio y tú solo intermediás, tu ingreso neto aproximado es 7–8 € por pedido antes de marketing.

## Ejemplo 2: B2B digital 99 € + 49 €/mes

| Concepto | Importe |
|---|---:|
| Setup | 99 € |
| Coste IA/plantillas | 5–10 € |
| Margen setup | 89–94 € |
| Mensual | 49 € |
| Coste mensual IA/soporte | 8–12 € |
| Margen mensual | 37–41 € |

Con 30 comercios a 49 €/mes:

```text
30 × 40 € ≈ 1.200 € margen mensual recurrente
```

## Ejemplo 3: Acompañamiento 19 €/mes

| Concepto | Importe |
|---|---:|
| Precio | 19 € |
| Coste variable | 3–5 € |
| Margen | 14–16 € |

Con 100 suscriptores:

```text
100 × 15 € = 1.500 € margen mensual
```

## Objetivo realista a 6 meses

| Métrica | Mes 1 | Mes 3 | Mes 6 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Pedidos únicos/mes | 10–20 | 60–100 | 150–250 |
| Suscripciones activas | 0–5 | 20–40 | 80–150 |
| GMV/mes | 500–1.500 € | 4.000–8.000 € | 10.000–20.000 € |
| Contribución neta/mes | 100–400 € | 1.000–2.500 € | 3.000–6.000 € |

---

# 8. Kill criteria: cuándo parar o pivotar

Esto faltaba en el chat anterior y es crítico.

| Señal | Umbral | Acción |
|---|---:|---|
| Menos de 3 pagos en 14 días con 100 contactos | <3 | Pivotar oferta |
| CAC > 50% LTV | >50% | Cambiar canal |
| Disputas | >5% | Pausar servicio |
| No-show proveedor | >10% | Revisar onboarding |
| Margen contribución negativo | <0 | Matar SKU |
| Riesgo legal alto | Cualquier caso | Humano + abogado |
| Fraude | >1% | Congelar pagos |
| IA con errores críticos | >2 incidentes/semana | Reducir autonomía |

---

# 9. Arquitectura técnica recomendada para mínimo mantenimiento

## Opción recomendada para 1 persona

| Capa | Herramienta | Razón |
|---|---|---|
| Frontend | Next.js en Vercel | Deploy automático, SEO, PWA |
| Backend | FastAPI en Railway/Fly.io | Python para IA, webhooks, tareas |
| Base de datos | Supabase PostgreSQL | Gestionada, backups, auth |
| Pagos | Stripe Connect | PCI delegado, escrow, payouts |
| WhatsApp | Meta WhatsApp Cloud API | Oficial, plantillas, opt-in |
| IA | OpenAI GPT-4o-mini / Claude Haiku | Bajo coste, structured output |
| Colas/tareas | Inngest / Trigger.dev / n8n | Orquestación sin DevOps |
| Analítica | PostHog / Plausible | Funnel, eventos |
| Errores | Sentry | Trazabilidad |
| Logs | Better Stack / Axiom | Observabilidad |
| Secretos | Doppler / Railway secrets | No claves en código |
| Seguridad | Cloudflare | WAF, DDoS |
| Firma | Signaturit / DocuSign | Contratos |
| KYC | Stripe Identity / Sumsub | Verificación |

## Coste mensual estimado

| Fase | Coste |
|---|---:|
| MVP validación | 0–50 €/mes + fees |
| Producción ligera | 50–150 €/mes + fees |
| Escala | 150–500 €/mes + fees |

El coste real más importante no es servidor: es **tiempo humano, disputas, marketing y errores**.

---

# 10. Modelo de datos mejorado

El schema anterior estaba bien para MVP, pero le faltaban piezas críticas.

## Entidades nuevas obligatorias

| Tabla | Función |
|---|---|
| opportunities | Oportunidades detectadas por Discovery Engine |
| experiments | Experimentos de validación |
| service_templates | Plantillas de servicios paquetizados |
| provider_capabilities | Qué puede hacer cada proveedor |
| ledger_entries | Contabilidad doble de pagos/comisiones |
| payouts | Pagos a proveedores |
| approvals | Aprobaciones humanas |
| ai_events | Logs de IA: prompt, modelo, decisión |
| incidents | Incidencias de seguridad/calidad |
| consents | Consentimientos RGPD |
| disputes_evidence | Evidencias de disputas |
| experiments_metrics | Resultados de A/B |
| notifications | Mensajes WhatsApp/email enviados |

## Ledger doble: crítico

No basta con guardar `orders.status = paid`.

Cada evento de dinero debe generar asientos compensados.

Ejemplo conceptual:

```text
Cliente paga 39 €
→ Cargo caja Stripe 39 €
→ Pasivo cliente 39 €

Servicio completado
→ Pasivo cliente 39 €
→ Ingreso comisión plataforma 9,75 €
→ Pagable proveedor 29,25 €

Fee Stripe
→ Gasto fee 1,20 €
→ Caja Stripe 1,20 €
```

Invariantes:

```text
Suma de ledger_entries por evento = 0
Toda transacción tiene idempotency_key
Todo webhook verifica firma
Todo payout requiere estado completed o aprobación humana
```

---

# 11. Pagos y Stripe Connect mejorados

## Errores del chat anterior

- Asumir que Stripe lo resuelve todo.
- No especificar verificación de webhook.
- No definir idempotencia.
- No definir payouts.
- No definir disputas.
- No definir fiscalidad.

## Flujo correcto

```text
Cliente acepta servicio
↓
Se crea Order con idempotency_key
↓
Stripe PaymentIntent o Checkout Session
↓
Webhook payment_intent.succeeded verificado
↓
Order pasa a paid_escrow
↓
Se asigna proveedor/fábrica
↓
Servicio se completa
↓
Cliente confirma o pasan 48 h sin disputa
↓
Liberación:
  - payout proveedor
  - comisión plataforma
  - fees
↓
Ledger registra asientos
```

## Reglas de liberación

| Riesgo | Liberación |
|---|---|
| Bajo | 24–48 h tras completar |
| Medio | 72 h |
| Alto | 7 días o aprobación humana |
| Disputa abierta | Congelado hasta resolución |

## Stripe Connect

Usa proveedor regulado. No custodies fondos si no tienes licencia.

Opciones:

- Stripe Connect Express.
- Stripe Connect Standard.
- Mangopay.
- Adyen for Platforms.
- Lemon Way.

Para España/UE, Stripe Connect es buena opción inicial, pero valida modelo de `destination charges`, `application_fee`, `separate charges and transfers` según tu rol legal.

---

# 12. WhatsApp Cloud API oficial: mejora crítica

El webhook simplificado del MVP sirve para pruebas, pero producción requiere formato oficial.

## Requisitos

- Opt-in del usuario.
- Plantillas aprobadas para iniciar conversación fuera de 24 h.
- Phone Number ID.
- Access Token.
- Verify token.
- Webhook signature/app verification.
- Control de costes por conversación.
- No spam.
- Baja fácil.

## Flujo oficial simplificado

```text
Usuario escribe con opt-in
↓
Meta envía webhook a /webhooks/whatsapp
↓
Backend valida payload
↓
IA clasifica
↓
Si responde dentro de 24 h: mensaje libre
↓
Si pasan 24 h: plantilla aprobada
↓
Se registra notification y consent
```

---

# 13. IA mejorada: de chatbot a agente gobernado

## Error anterior

Dar a la IA un rol casi total sin límites formales.

## Mejora v3

La IA debe operar como **agente con herramientas limitadas**.

### Herramientas permitidas

```text
get_services
get_service_by_slug
create_lead
create_order
create_payment_link
get_order_status
schedule_service
request_human_handoff
log_dispute_evidence
get_provider_availability
create_digital_deliverable_draft
```

### Herramientas prohibidas para IA

```text
change_commission
modify_legal_terms
delete_user_data
approve_payout
ban_provider
change_bank_account
deploy_code
modify_production_database
refund_payment
change_admin_credentials
```

## Structured output obligatorio

La IA debe devolver JSON válido:

```json
{
  "reply_to_user": "string",
  "intent": "support_digital | commerce | repair | price | complaint | other",
  "risk_level": "low | medium | high",
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "suggested_service_slug": "string",
  "missing_fields": [],
  "next_action": "propose_service | ask_info | schedule | escalate_human",
  "escalate_human": false,
  "legal_flags": [],
  "cost_estimate_eur": 0.0,
  "evidence": []
}
```

## Defensa contra prompt injection

Reglas:

1. El mensaje del usuario es dato, no instrucción.
2. La IA no ejecuta instrucciones embebidas en textos externos.
3. Toda herramienta tiene allowlist.
4. Toda acción sensible requiere aprobación.
5. No revelar system prompt completo.
6. No pegar DNI, IBAN, salud o menores en prompts.
7. Hash de teléfono en logs.
8. Evaluar salidas con filtros de riesgo.

---

# 14. Agentes recomendados: 8, no 20

| Agente | Función | Autonomía | Límite |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Orchestrator | Coordina flujo | Alta | No acciones irreversibles |
| Scout | Detecta oportunidades | Media | Humano aprueba experimento |
| Intake | Atiende leads | Alta | Escala riesgo alto |
| Matcher | Asigna proveedor | Alta | Excepciones a humano |
| Producer | Genera entregables digitales | Alta | Riesgo medio/alto revisión |
| Risk | Fraude/disputas | Media | Bloqueo definitivo humano |
| Finance | Ledger, informes | Media | Pagos/refunds humano |
| Learning | Experimentos/optimización | Media | Deploy crítico humano |

---

# 15. Prompt maestro mejorado

```text
Eres SAIPS-AMOS Lite v3, orquestador operativo de una plataforma local de servicios gestionada por una persona humana.

Objetivo:
Convertir necesidades locales en servicios validados, pagados, entregados y rentables, con mínima intervención humana rutinaria.

Jerarquía de decisión:
1. Seguridad y legalidad.
2. Confianza del cliente.
3. Calidad del servicio.
4. Rentabilidad.
5. Velocidad.
6. Escalabilidad.

Reglas obligatorias:
- No des consejos legales, fiscales, sanitarios, financieros o administrativos vinculantes.
- Si detectas emergencia, salud, menores, violencia, fraude, abuso, prensa o regulador, escala a humano.
- No pidas datos innecesarios.
- No almacenes DNI, salud, menores o IBAN fuera de sistemas aprobados.
- No prometas resultados garantizados salvo garantía aprobada.
- Usa solo servicios del catálogo activo.
- Toda acción con dinero, proveedor, disputa, datos personales o producción requiere registro auditable.
- Si la confianza es baja, pide confirmación humana.

Formato de salida:
Devuelve siempre JSON válido con:
{
  "reply_to_user": "...",
  "intent": "...",
  "risk_level": "low|medium|high",
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "suggested_service_slug": "...",
  "missing_fields": [],
  "next_action": "...",
  "escalate_human": false,
  "legal_flags": [],
  "cost_estimate_eur": 0.0
}
```

---

# 16. Autoactualización segura

El chat anterior hablaba de autoevolución total. Eso es peligroso sin gobierno.

## Pipeline correcto

```text
Idea de mejora
↓
Diseño
↓
Evaluación offline
↓
Sandbox
↓
Shadow mode
↓
Canary 5%
↓
Métricas
↓
Aprobación humana si impacto crítico
↓
Producción
↓
Monitorización
↓
Rollback automático si degrada
```

## Qué puede autoactualizarse

| Cambio | Automático | Condición |
|---|---:|---|
| Textos de landing | Sí | Sin claims legales |
| Respuestas FAQ | Sí | Eval de riesgo |
| Prompts internos | Parcial | Canary + evals |
| Ranking de servicios | Sí | Transparencia P2B |
| Precios | No | Bandas + humano |
| Comisiones | No | Humano |
| Código crítico | No | Tests + aprobación |
| Contratos | No | Abogado |
| Pagos | No | Reglas + humano |
| Borrado de datos | No | RGPD + aprobación |
| Nuevos servicios regulados | No | Legal |

---

# 17. Legal mejorado: UE/España

## Normativa clave

| Área | Norma | Implicación |
|---|---|---|
| Datos | RGPD 2016/679 | Consentimiento, minimización, DPIA |
| Datos España | LO 3/2018 | Adaptación local |
| Servicios digitales | LSSI 34/2002 | Información, cookies |
| Consumidores | RDL 1/2007 | Garantías, cláusulas |
| Plataformas | P2B 2019/1150 | Ranking, términos, transparencia |
| Servicios digitales UE | DSA 2022/2065 | Moderación, reclamaciones |
| Mercados digitales | DMA 2022/1925 | Solo si gatekeeper |
| Pagos | PSD2 2015/2366 | No custodiar fondos sin licencia |
| IA | AI Act, Reglamento UE 2024/1689 | Riesgo, transparencia, logs |
| Trabajo plataformas | Directiva UE aprobada 2024 | Presunción laboral, gestión algorítmica |
| Fiscal plataformas | DAC7 | Reporte de vendedores |
| Fiscal España | AEAT | IVA, IRPF, IS, modelos |

## Documentos mínimos v3

1. Términos y condiciones.
2. Política de privacidad.
3. Política de cookies.
4. Política de disputas.
5. Política de reembolsos.
6. Contrato de proveedor.
7. DPA con proveedores.
8. Registro de actividades de tratamiento.
9. Aviso de IA.
10. Política de conservación de datos.
11. Política de seguridad.
12. Política de ranking/transparencia.
13. Condiciones de suscripción.
14. Condiciones de servicios digitales.
15. Condiciones de servicios presenciales.

## Aviso de IA recomendado

```text
Utilizamos sistemas de IA para clasificar solicitudes, proponer servicios, generar documentos y mejorar la atención. Las decisiones relevantes pueden ser revisadas por una persona. Puedes solicitar intervención humana, expresar tu punto de vista e impugnar decisiones automatizadas cuando legalmente corresponda.
```

---

# 18. Riesgo laboral: punto crítico

Si controlas demasiado a los proveedores, puedes generar relación laboral.

## Señales de riesgo

- Precio fijado completamente por ti.
- Horario impuesto.
- Uniforme obligatorio.
- Exclusividad.
- Instrucciones detalladas.
- Sanciones.
- Dependencia económica.
- Imposibilidad de trabajar para otros.

                "market_size_estimate": estimate_tam(signals),
                "trend_velocity": calculate_velocity(signals),
                "competition_level": assess_competition(signals),
                "regulatory_risk": check_legality(signals)
            }
    
    def rank_opportunities(self, all_opportunities):
        """Ordenar por viabilidad + upside potencial"""
        scored = []
        for opp in all_opportunities:
            score = (
                opp["confidence"] * 0.3 +
                opp["market_size_estimate"] / 1_000_000 * 0.3 +
                opp["trend_velocity"] * 0.2 +
                (1 - opp["competition_level"]) * 0.2
            )
            scored.append((score, opp))
        
        return sorted(scored, reverse=True)[:10]  # Top 10 oportunidades semanales

        return {
            "by_viability": sorted(solutions, key=lambda x: x["viability_score"], reverse=True)[:3],
            "by_roi": sorted(solutions, key=lambda x: x["roi_expected"], reverse=True)[:3],
            "by_speed": sorted(solutions, key=lambda x: x["break_even_months"])[:3],
            "all_candidates": solutions  # Para auditoría
        }
    
    async def monte_carlo_simulation(self, solution, opportunity, n=10000):
        """Simular 10,000 ejecuciones del plan"""
        outcomes = []
        
        for simulation_id in range(n):
            # Parámetros estocásticos
            market_penetration = random.gauss(0.05, 0.02)  # Media 5%, sigma 2%
            churn_rate = random.gauss(0.03, 0.01)
            cac = random.gauss(solution["initial_investment_euros"] / 100, 10)
            ltv = cac * (1 / churn_rate) if churn_rate > 0 else cac * 12
            
            # Simulación temporal (24 meses)
            cash_flow = simulate_24_months(
                initial_cash=solution["initial_investment_euros"],
                monthly_users=opportunity["tam"] * market_penetration / 24,
                cac=cac,
                ltv=ltv,
                churn=churn_rate,
                burn_rate=solution["initial_investment_euros"] / 12
            )
            
            # Outcome
            final_cash = sum(cash_flow)
            roi = final_cash / solution["initial_investment_euros"] if final_cash > 0 else 0
            
            outcomes.append({
                "roi": roi,
                "final_cash": final_cash,
                "drawdown": min(cash_flow),
                "months_to_breakeven": next((i for i, cf in enumerate(cash_flow) if cf > 0), None)
            })
        
        return {
            "success_probability": len([o for o in outcomes if o["roi"] > 1]) / n,
            "expected_roi": mean([o["roi"] for o in outcomes]),
            "roi_percentile_10": percentile([o["roi"] for o in outcomes], 0.1),
            "roi_percentile_90": percentile([o["roi"] for o in outcomes], 0.9),
            "drawdown_max": min([o["drawdown"] for o in outcomes]),
            "median_breakeven_months": median([o["months_to_breakeven"] for o in outcomes if o["months_to_breakeven"]])
        }

class AutonomousEconomy:
    def __init__(self, capital_euros: int):
        self.total_capital = capital_euros
        self.cash_available = capital_euros
        self.cash_deployed = {}  # business_id → euros
        self.cash_reserved = {}   # risk mitigation pools
        self.revenue_streams = {}  # business_id → cumulative revenue
    
    async def allocate_capital(self, businesses_pending_approval: list):
        """Decidir cuánto capital asignar a cada negocio"""
        
        for business in businesses_pending_approval:
            # 1. Calcular risk-adjusted capital allocation
            required_capital = business.initial_investment_euros
            roi_expected = business.roi_expected
            risk_score = business.risk_profile
            
            # Kelly Criterion para inversión óptima
            kelly_fraction = (roi_expected * 0.85 - (1 - 0.85)) / roi_expected if roi_expected > 1 else 0.1
            kelly_fraction = max(0.05, min(0.3, kelly_fraction))  # Limitar entre 5% y 30% del capital
            
            allocated_capital = int(self.total_capital * kelly_fraction)
            
            # 2. Verificar si hay capital disponible
            if allocated_capital > self.cash_available:
                allocated_capital = int(self.cash_available * 0.1)  # Asignar 10% de lo disponible
            
            # 3. Reservar capital para riesgos (10% adicional)
            reserved = int(allocated_capital * 0.1)
            
            # 4. Registrar
            self.cash_deployed[business.id] = allocated_capital
            self.cash_reserved[business.id] = reserved
            self.cash_available -= (allocated_capital + reserved)
            
            logger.info(f"Capital assigned to {business.name}: {allocated_capital}€ (risk: {risk_score})")
    
    async def manage_revenue_streams(self):
        """Recolectar ingresos, pagar deudas, reinvertir"""
        
        for business_id, revenue in self.revenue_streams.items():
            # 1. Pagar costes de operación
            opex = self.get_opex(business_id)
            net_revenue = revenue - opex
            
            # 2. Calcular impuestos (20% simplificado)
            taxes = int(net_revenue * 0.2)
            available_for_deployment = net_revenue - taxes
            
            # 3. Decidir: reinvertir o acumular
            if self.should_reinvest(business_id):
                # Reinvertir 70% en expansion
                self.cash_available += int(available_for_deployment * 0.7)
                # Guardar 30% como reserva
                self.reserves += int(available_for_deployment * 0.3)
            else:
                # Si el negocio es estable, guardar todo
                self.reserves += available_for_deployment
    
    async def rebalance_portfolio(self):
        """Cada semana: revisar si capital está bien asignado"""
        
        for business_id, capital_deployed in self.cash_deployed.items():
            roi_actual = self.calculate_roi(business_id)
            roi_target = self.businesses[business_id].roi_target
            
            # Si ROI cae 30% por debajo del target, reducir capital
            if roi_actual < roi_target * 0.7:
                await self.governance_council.debate_and_vote({
                    "action": "REDUCE_CAPITAL",
                    "business_id": business_id,
                    "reason": f"ROI {roi_actual} < target {roi_target}"
                })

"""
AUREA X — Universal Memory
Registro inmutable tipo hash-chain. Todo evento queda auditado.
Sin memoria no hay aprendizaje. Sin aprendizaje no hay evolución.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import sqlite3
import threading
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class UniversalMemory:
    """
    Append-only ledger con hash chain.
    Cada evento referencia el hash anterior → cadena de custodia.
    Almacenamiento: SQLite local (MVP) → PostgreSQL (producción).
    """

    def __init__(self, db_path: str = "aurea_x_memory.db"):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._last_hash: str = "GENESIS"
        self._init_db()
        self._recover_last_hash()

    def _init_db(self):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
                    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    event_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
                )
            """)
            conn.execute("""
                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_type
                ON events(event_type)
            """)
            conn.execute("""
                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_created
                ON events(created_at)
            """)
            conn.commit()

    def _recover_last_hash(self):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT event_hash FROM events ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1"
            ).fetchone()
            if row:
                self._last_hash = row[0]

    @staticmethod
    def _compute_hash(payload: dict, previous_hash: str) -> str:
        canonical = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, default=str)
        raw = f"{previous_hash}|{canonical}"
        return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()

    def log(self, event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        with self._lock:
            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            event_hash = self._compute_hash(payload, self._last_hash)

            with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
                conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO events (event_type, payload, previous_hash, event_hash, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (
                        event_type,
                        json.dumps(payload, default=str),
                        self._last_hash,
                        event_hash,
                        now,
                    ),
                )
                conn.commit()

            self._last_hash = event_hash
            return event_hash

    def query(
        self,
        event_type: str | None = None,
        since: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 100,
    ) -> list[dict]:
        clauses = []
        params: list = []

        if event_type:
            clauses.append("event_type = ?")
            params.append(event_type)
        if since:
            clauses.append("created_at >= ?")
            params.append(since)

        where = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
        sql = f"SELECT seq, event_type, payload, event_hash, created_at FROM events {where} ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT ?"
        params.append(limit)

        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            rows = conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall()

        return [
            {
                "seq": r[0],
                "event_type": r[1],
                "payload": json.loads(r[2]),
                "hash": r[3],
                "created_at": r[4],
            }
            for r in rows
        ]

    def verify_chain(self) -> bool:
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT payload, previous_hash, event_hash FROM events ORDER BY seq ASC"
            ).fetchall()

        prev = "GENESIS"
        for payload_str, stored_prev, stored_hash in rows:
            if stored_prev != prev:
                return False
            expected = self._compute_hash(json.loads(payload_str), stored_prev)
            if expected != stored_hash:
                return False
            prev = stored_hash
        return True

    def stats(self) -> dict:
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            total = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events").fetchone()[0]
            by_type = conn.execute(
                "SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC"
            ).fetchall()
        return {
            "total_events": total,
            "by_type": {t: c for t, c in by_type},
            "chain_valid": self.verify_chain(),
        }

"""
AUREA X — Digital Twin
Simulación Monte Carlo de 90 días antes de lanzar cualquier negocio.
Si el gemelo falla, el negocio NO se despliega en el mundo real.

Fundamento:
- Monte Carlo: Metropolis & Ulam (1949), "The Monte Carlo Method".
- Simulación de negocios: Forrester (1961), Industrial Dynamics.
- Validación antes de escala: Ries (2011), The Lean Startup.
"""

import random
import statistics
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone


@dataclass
class TwinConfig:
    initial_capital_eur: float = 5_000.0
    projected_daily_leads: float = 10.0
    conversion_rate: float = 0.08
    avg_ticket_eur: float = 45.0
    commission_bps: int = 2500
    daily_opex_eur: float = 15.0
    monthly_churn_rate: float = 0.05
    cac_eur: float = 8.0
    dispute_rate: float = 0.03
    refund_rate: float = 0.5
    simulation_days: int = 90
    monte_carlo_runs: int = 5_000
    roi_target: float = 1.2
    max_drawdown_tolerance_eur: float = 2_000.0


@dataclass
class DayResult:
    day: int
    leads: int
    conversions: int
    revenue_eur: float
    opex_eur: float
    disputes_eur: float
    net_eur: float
    cumulative_net_eur: float


@dataclass
class SimulationOutcome:
    run_id: int
    total_revenue_eur: float
    total_opex_eur: float
    total_disputes_eur: float
    net_profit_eur: float
    roi: float
    max_drawdown_eur: float
    days_to_breakeven: int | None
    daily_results: list[DayResult] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class TwinVerdict:
    status: str  # PASS | FAIL | CONDITIONAL
    success_probability: float
    median_roi: float
    p10_roi: float
    p90_roi: float
    median_breakeven_days: int | None
    max_drawdown_p95_eur: float
    total_runs: int
    passing_runs: int
    failure_modes: list[str]
    recommendations: list[str]
    generated_at: str


class DigitalTwin:

    def __init__(self, config: TwinConfig | None = None):
        self.config = config or TwinConfig()

    def run_single_simulation(self, run_id: int) -> SimulationOutcome:
        cfg = self.config
        cash = cfg.initial_capital_eur
        cumulative_net = 0.0
        peak_cash = cash
        max_drawdown = 0.0
        breakeven_day: int | None = None
        daily_results: list[DayResult] = []
        active_subscribers = 0

        for day in range(1, cfg.simulation_days + 1):
            leads = max(0, int(random.gauss(cfg.projected_daily_leads, cfg.projected_daily_leads * 0.3)))
            conv_rate = max(0.01, random.gauss(cfg.conversion_rate, cfg.conversion_rate * 0.25))
            conversions = int(leads * conv_rate)

            ticket = max(10.0, random.gauss(cfg.avg_ticket_eur, cfg.avg_ticket_eur * 0.15))
            commission_rate = cfg.commission_bps / 10_000
            gross_revenue = conversions * ticket * commission_rate

            active_subscribers = int(
                active_subscribers * (1 - cfg.monthly_churn_rate / 30) + conversions * 0.2
            )
            subscription_revenue = active_subscribers * 19.0 * 0.8 / 30

            revenue = gross_revenue + subscription_revenue

            opex = max(5.0, random.gauss(cfg.daily_opex_eur, cfg.daily_opex_eur * 0.2))
            cac_spend = conversions * max(1.0, random.gauss(cfg.cac_eur, cfg.cac_eur * 0.3))

            disputes = 0.0
            if conversions > 0 and random.random() < cfg.dispute_rate:
                disputes = conversions * ticket * cfg.refund_rate * commission_rate

            net = revenue - opex - cac_spend - disputes
            cash += net
            cumulative_net += net

            if cash > peak_cash:
                peak_cash = cash
            drawdown = peak_cash - cash
            if drawdown > max_drawdown:
                max_drawdown = drawdown

            if breakeven_day is None and cumulative_net > 0:
                breakeven_day = day

            daily_results.append(
                DayResult(
                    day=day,
                    leads=leads,
                    conversions=conversions,
                    revenue_eur=round(revenue, 2),
                    opex_eur=round(opex + cac_spend, 2),
                    disputes_eur=round(disputes, 2),
                    net_eur=round(net, 2),
                    cumulative_net_eur=round(cumulative_net, 2),
                )
            )

        total_revenue = sum(d.revenue_eur for d in daily_results)
        total_opex = sum(d.opex_eur for d in daily_results)
        total_disputes = sum(d.disputes_eur for d in daily_results)
        net_profit = total_revenue - total_opex - total_disputes
        roi = (net_profit / cfg.initial_capital_eur) if cfg.initial_capital_eur > 0 else 0.0

        return SimulationOutcome(
            run_id=run_id,
            total_revenue_eur=round(total_revenue, 2),
            total_opex_eur=round(total_opex, 2),
            total_disputes_eur=round(total_disputes, 2),
            net_profit_eur=round(net_profit, 2),
            roi=round(roi, 4),
            max_drawdown_eur=round(max_drawdown, 2),
            days_to_breakeven=breakeven_day,
            daily_results=daily_results,
        )

    def run_monte_carlo(self) -> list[SimulationOutcome]:
        return [
            self.run_single_simulation(i)
            for i in range(self.config.monte_carlo_runs)
        ]

    def evaluate(self, outcomes: list[SimulationOutcome]) -> TwinVerdict:
        cfg = self.config
        rois = [o.roi for o in outcomes]
        drawdowns = [o.max_drawdown_eur for o in outcomes]
        breakevens = [o.days_to_breakeven for o in outcomes if o.days_to_breakeven is not None]

        passing = [o for o in outcomes if o.roi >= cfg.roi_target]
        success_prob = len(passing) / len(outcomes) if outcomes else 0.0

        rois_sorted = sorted(rois)
        n = len(rois_sorted)
        p10 = rois_sorted[int(n * 0.10)] if n > 0 else 0.0
        p50 = statistics.median(rois_sorted) if n > 0 else 0.0
        p90 = rois_sorted[int(n * 0.90)] if n > 0 else 0.0

        dd_sorted = sorted(drawdowns, reverse=True)
        dd_p95 = dd_sorted[int(len(dd_sorted) * 0.05)] if dd_sorted else 0.0

        failure_modes: list[str] = []
        recommendations: list[str] = []

        if success_prob < 0.5:
            failure_modes.append("Probabilidad de éxito inferior al 50%")
            recommendations.append("Reducir opex diario o aumentar ticket medio")

        if dd_p95 > cfg.max_drawdown_tolerance_eur:
            failure_modes.append(f"Drawdown P95 ({dd_p95:.0f}€) supera tolerancia ({cfg.max_drawdown_tolerance_eur:.0f}€)")
            recommendations.append("Reducir inversión inicial o añadir reserva de contingencia")

        if breakevens and statistics.median(breakevens) > 60:
            failure_modes.append("Mediana de breakeven superior a 60 días")
            recommendations.append("Acelerar conversión con mejor oferta o canal")

        if p10 < 0:

"""
AUREA X — Evolutionary System
Auto-mejora de todos los componentes con evaluación rigurosa.
Ningún cambio entra en producción sin superar evals + shadow + canary.

Fundamento:
- Experimentación: Kohavi, Tang & Xu (2020), Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments.
- Continuous Delivery: Humble & Farley (2010).
- Evals de IA: OpenAI Evals framework (2023).
- Bandits: Sutton & Barto (2018), Reinforcement Learning, cap. 2.
"""

import random
import statistics
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum


class ComponentStatus(Enum):
    STABLE = "stable"
    CANDIDATE = "candidate"
    SHADOW = "shadow"
    CANARY = "canary"
    PROMOTED = "promoted"
    ROLLED_BACK = "rolled_back"


@dataclass
class ComponentVersion:
    component_name: str
    version: int
    config: dict
    status: ComponentStatus = ComponentStatus.STABLE
    eval_score: float = 0.0
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    promoted_at: str | None = None
    rolled_back_at: str | None = None


@dataclass
class EvalResult:
    component_name: str
    version_a: int
    version_b: int
    score_a: float
    score_b: float
    improvement_pct: float
    sample_size: int
    statistically_significant: bool
    verdict: str
    evaluated_at: str


@dataclass
class EvolutionEvent:
    component_name: str
    from_version: int
    to_version: int
    trigger: str
    improvement_pct: float
    approved_by: str
    timestamp: str


class EvolutionarySystem:

    MIN_IMPROVEMENT_PCT = 2.0
    MIN_SAMPLE_SIZE = 100
    CANARY_TRAFFIC_PCT = 5.0
    CANARY_DURATION_HOURS = 48

    def __init__(self, memory=None):
        self.memory = memory
        self.registry: dict[str, list[ComponentVersion]] = {}
        self.evolution_log: list[EvolutionEvent] = []

    def register_component(self, name: str, version: int, config: dict):
        cv = ComponentVersion(
            component_name=name,
            version=version,
            config=config,
            status=ComponentStatus.STABLE,
        )
        if name not in self.registry:
            self.registry[name] = []
        self.registry[name].append(cv)

    def get_active_version(self, name: str) -> ComponentVersion | None:
        versions = self.registry.get(name, [])
        for v in reversed(versions):
            if v.status in (ComponentStatus.STABLE, ComponentStatus.PROMOTED):
                return v
        return versions[-1] if versions else None

    def propose_candidate(self, name: str, new_config: dict) -> ComponentVersion | None:
        versions = self.registry.get(name, [])
        if not versions:
            return None

        current = self.get_active_version(name)
        if not current:
            return None

        new_version = current.version + 1
        candidate = ComponentVersion(
            component_name=name,
            version=new_version,
            config=new_config,
            status=ComponentStatus.CANDIDATE,
        )
        versions.append(candidate)

        if self.memory:
            self.memory.log(
                "evolution_candidate_proposed",
                {
                    "component": name,
                    "version": new_version,
                    "config_diff": self._diff_configs(current.config, new_config),
                },
            )

        return candidate

    @staticmethod
    def _diff_configs(a: dict, b: dict) -> dict:
        diff = {}
        all_keys = set(list(a.keys()) + list(b.keys()))
        for k in all_keys:
            va = a.get(k)
            vb = b.get(k)
            if va != vb:
                diff[k] = {"from": va, "to": vb}
        return diff

    def run_eval(
        self,
        name: str,
        version_a: int,
        version_b: int,
        golden_set_size: int = 200,
    ) -> EvalResult:
        versions = {v.version: v for v in self.registry.get(name, [])}
        va = versions.get(version_a)
        vb = versions.get(version_b)

        if not va or not vb:
            raise ValueError(f"Version not found for {name}")

        score_a = self._simulate_eval_score(va.config, golden_set_size)
        score_b = self._simulate_eval_score(vb.config, golden_set_size)

        improvement = ((score_b - score_a) / max(score_a, 0.001)) * 100
        significant = abs(improvement) > self.MIN_IMPROVEMENT_PCT and golden_set_size >= self.MIN_SAMPLE_SIZE

        if significant and improvement > 0:
            verdict = "PROMOTE"
        elif significant and improvement < 0:
            verdict = "REJECT"
        else:
            verdict = "INCONCLUSIVE"

        result = EvalResult(
            component_name=name,
            version_a=version_a,
            version_b=version_b,
            score_a=round(score_a, 4),
            score_b=round(score_b, 4),
            improvement_pct=round(improvement, 2),
            sample_size=golden_set_size,
            statistically_significant=significant,
            verdict=verdict,
            evaluated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        )

        if self.memory:
            self.memory.log("evolution_eval", result.__dict__)

        return result

    @staticmethod
    def _simulate_eval_score(config: dict, n: int) -> float:
        base = config.get("quality_weight", 0.7)
        noise = random.gauss(0, 0.03)
        scores = [min(1.0, max(0.0, base + random.gauss(0, 0.1) + noise)) for _ in range(n)]
        return statistics.mean(scores)

    def promote(self, name: str, version: int, approved_by: str = "governance_council"):
        versions = self.registry.get(name, [])
        for v in versions:
            if v.version == version:
                v.status = ComponentStatus.PROMOTED
                v.promoted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

                for other in versions:
                    if other.version != version and other.status in (
                        ComponentStatus.STABLE,
                        ComponentStatus.PROMOTED,
                    ):
                        other.status = ComponentStatus.ROLLED_BACK
                        other.rolled_back_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

                if self.memory:
                    self.memory.log(
                        "evolution_promoted",
                        {"component": name, "version": version, "approved_by": approved_by},
                    )
                return

        raise ValueError(f"Version {version} not found for {name}")

    def rollback(self, name: str, version: int, reason: str):
        versions = self.registry.get(name, [])
        for v in versions:
            if v.version == version:
                v.status = ComponentStatus.ROLLED_BACK
                v.rolled_back_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

                previous = [
                    pv for pv in versions
                    if pv.version < version and pv.status != ComponentStatus.ROLLED_BACK
                ]
                if previous:
                    prev = previous[-1]
                    prev.status = ComponentStatus.STABLE

                if self.memory:
                    self.memory.log(
                        "evolution_rollback",
                        {"component": name, "version": version, "reason": reason},
                    )
                return

        raise ValueError(f"Version {version} not found for {name}")

    def run_evolution_cycle(self, component_configs: dict[str, dict]):
        for name, new_config in component_configs.items():
            current = self.get_active_version(name)
            if not current:
                self.register_component(name, 1, new_config)
                continue

            candidate = self.propose_candidate(name, new_config)
            if not candidate:
                continue

            eval_result = self.run_eval(name, current.version, candidate.version)

            if eval_result.verdict == "PROMOTE":
                self.promote(name, candidate.version)
                self.evolution_log.append(
                    EvolutionEvent(
                        component_name=name,
                        from_version=current.version,
                        to_version=candidate.version,
                        trigger="eval_improvement",
                        improvement_pct=eval_result.improvement_pct,
                        approved_by="evolutionary_system",
                        timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                    )
                )
            elif eval_result.verdict == "REJECT":
                self.rollback(name, candidate.version, "eval_regression")
            else:
                candidate.status = ComponentStatus.ROLLED_BACK

    def report(self) -> dict:
        active = {}
        for name, versions in self.registry.items():
            current = self.get_active_version(name)
            if current:
                active[name] = {
                    "version": current.version,
                    "status": current.status.value,
                    "eval_score": current.eval_score,
                }

        return {
            "active_components": active,
            "total_evolution_events": len(self.evolution_log),
            "recent_events": [
                {
                    "component": e.component_name,
                    "from": e.from_version,
                    "to": e.to_version,
                    "improvement_pct": e.improvement_pct,
                    "timestamp": e.timestamp,
                }
                for e in self.evolution_log[-10:]
            ],
        }

        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "invention", "status": "completed", "count": len(solutions)})
        return solutions

    def _phase_governance(self, solutions: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "governance", "status": "started"})

        approved = []
        for sol in solutions:
            votes = {
                "market": sol["roi_expected"] > 1.2,
                "tech": True,
                "legal": sol["risk_profile"] < 0.6,
                "finance": sol["roi_expected"] > 1.1,
                "ethics": True,
                "ops": sol["initial_investment_eur"] < 10_000,
                "comply": sol["risk_profile"] < 0.5,
            }
            approval_rate = sum(votes.values()) / len(votes)

            if approval_rate >= 0.85:
                sol["governance_status"] = "APPROVED"
                sol["governance_score"] = approval_rate
                approved.append(sol)
            else:
                sol["governance_status"] = "REJECTED"
                sol["governance_score"] = approval_rate

        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "governance", "status": "completed", "approved": len(approved)})
        return approved

    def _phase_digital_twin(self, solutions: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "digital_twin", "status": "started"})

        results = []
        for sol in solutions:
            config = TwinConfig(
                initial_capital_eur=sol["initial_investment_eur"],
                projected_daily_leads=10,
                conversion_rate=0.08,
                avg_ticket_eur=45.0,
                commission_bps=2500,
                daily_opex_eur=15.0,
                cac_eur=sol.get("base_cac_eur", 8.0),
                monte_carlo_runs=2_000,
                roi_target=sol.get("roi_expected", 1.2),
            )
            twin = DigitalTwin(config)
            verdict = twin.run_full_evaluation()

            result = {
                "solution_id": sol["id"],
                "status": verdict.status,
                "success_probability": verdict.success_probability,
                "median_roi": verdict.median_roi,
                "median_breakeven_days": verdict.median_breakeven_days,
                "failure_modes": verdict.failure_modes,
                "recommendations": verdict.recommendations,
            }
            results.append(result)

            self.memory.log("digital_twin_result", result)

        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "digital_twin", "status": "completed"})
        return results

    def _phase_territorial(self, deployable: list) -> dict:
        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "territorial", "status": "started"})

        expansion_results = []
        for sol, twin_result in deployable:
            business_profile = {
                "elderly_relevance": 0.8,
                "digital_gap_relevance": 0.7,
                "smb_relevance": 0.6,
                "base_cac_eur": sol.get("base_cac_eur", 8.0),
                "base_monthly_revenue_eur": sol.get("projected_monthly_revenue_eur", 1_500),
            }

            candidates = self.territorial.rank_expansion_targets(
                business_slug=sol["id"],
                business_profile=business_profile,
                source_territory_id="es-ct-bcn-lh-pubilla",
            )

            expansion_results.append({
                "solution_id": sol["id"],
                "expansion_targets": [
                    {
                        "territory": c.territory_name,
                        "fit_score": c.fit_score,
                        "risk": c.risk_level,
                        "recommendation": c.recommendation,
                        "adaptations": c.adaptation_required,
                    }
                    for c in candidates[:3]
                ],
            })

        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "territorial", "status": "completed"})
        return {"expansion_plans": expansion_results}

    def _phase_economy(self, deployable: list) -> dict:
        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "economy", "status": "started"})

        total_capital = 10_000.0
        allocations = []

        for sol, twin_result in deployable:
            roi = sol.get("roi_expected", 1.0)
            risk = sol.get("risk_profile", 0.5)

            kelly = max(0.05, min(0.25, (roi * 0.6 - 0.4) / max(roi, 0.01)))
            allocated = round(total_capital * kelly, 2)

            allocations.append({
                "solution_id": sol["id"],
                "allocated_eur": allocated,
                "kelly_fraction": round(kelly, 4),
                "expected_roi": roi,
                "risk": risk,
            })

        total_allocated = sum(a["allocated_eur"] for a in allocations)

        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "economy", "status": "completed"})
        return {
            "total_capital_eur": total_capital,
            "total_allocated_eur": total_allocated,
            "reserve_eur": round(total_capital - total_allocated, 2),
            "allocations": allocations,
        }

    def _phase_evolution(self) -> dict:
        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "evolution", "status": "started"})

        component_updates = {
            "intake_agent": {"quality_weight": 0.75, "model": "gpt-4o-mini"},
            "pricing_engine": {"quality_weight": 0.72, "strategy": "bandit"},
            "matching_algorithm": {"quality_weight": 0.78, "weights": "optimized"},
        }

        self.evolution.run_evolution_cycle(component_updates)
        report = self.evolution.report()

        self.memory.log("phase", {"phase": "evolution", "status": "completed"})
        return report

    print(f"Memoria: aurea_x_memory.db")

if __name__ == "__main__":

## Reflexión prospectiva

AUREA X ya tiene los 10 componentes estructurales. Pero el sistema es tan bueno como sus datos de entrada y sus límites de gobernanza. Un Discovery Engine sin APIs reales produce oportunidades ficticias. Un Digital Twin sin datos históricos reales simula sobre supuestos. Un Evolutionary System sin golden sets reales optimiza ruido.

La próxima frontera no es más código. Es:

1. **Conectar APIs reales** (Google Trends, Reddit, GitHub, BOE, EUR-Lex).
2. **Alimentar el Digital Twin con datos reales** del piloto en Pubilla Cases.
3. **Construir golden sets de evaluación** con transacciones reales.
4. **Validar la gobernanza** con casos límite reales (disputas, fraudes, regulación).
